mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below its 5-year moving average, combined with a simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5%, signals a weakening demand environment that depresses corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint GDPC1/UNRATE signal fails to explain > 15% of variance in 20d returns (R-squared < 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average, coupled with a decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 6-month moving average, signals a supply-side imbalance where manufacturing expansion outpaces housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or the INDPRO/HOUST interaction fails to explain > 20% of variance in 60d returns (R-squared < 0.20).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5%, combined with a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below its 12-month moving average, signals a weakening labor market that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the UNRATE/PAYEMS signal fails to explain > 15% of variance in 20d returns (R-squared < 0.15).
